component.name: LED Badge Studio
component.summary: Design messages and send them to USB LED badges

description.p: An editor and uploader for the common USB LED name badges (USB ID 0416:5020) sold under many brand names. It replaces the vendor's Windows-only "BMP Badge LED" software.

ul.li: Up to eight messages with text, icons, images or your own drawings
All the badge's effects (scrolling, snow, curtain, laser, flash, border) with a live preview
Saves projects as .badge files that open with a double-click

description.p: On first use, Badge Access sets up the system rule that lets your account write to the badge (asks for your password).

Shows the send's progress on the taskbar button on KDE Plasma and Ubuntu's dock, keeps unsaved work safe with several windows open, exports in the format of the typed file name, and fixes saving through links, damaged files and long serial uploads.
Picks the USB badge before a computer's own serial port, and stops a send to a serial device that doesn't take the data instead of waiting forever.
